notes: Passive contextual display. Label purpose = visual aid, aria-hidden, not rendered in textonly. Info purpose = real content, announced. Assistive render handled via [data-render='assistive'] in assistive-gate.css (info-purpose becomes always-visible bar, label-purpose hidden). Visual treatment shared with FigCaption + shared-bar via the --bar-* token family. Consumer owns aria-describedby on their focusable element — Tooltip provides id on content.

contentTooltip._note: Primary tooltip text. Renders through Text atom. Mutually exclusive with rich slot content.

aac._note: Build AAC inline HTML from contentTooltip at build time. True by default.

purpose._note: Label = visual duplicate of trigger's aria-label (hidden from SR). Info = new information (announced via aria-describedby).

id._note: Unique ID for aria-describedby linking. Auto-generated as `tooltip-<random6chars>` if not provided.

textTone._note: Text tone override; passed to Text atom.
